How It Works

Simple steps · No account needed · Completely FREE

1. Upload

Import any GLB/GLTF model. Drag & drop or choose a file.

2. Customize

Click any part of the model or use the color tools.

3. Export

Download your custom-colored GLB. You can even name the file using our auto-prompt.
